name: Ch.3 · The River Rose
gameInstructions: Tap every iron chariot before it crosses the rushing Kishon.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sisera came with iron chariots, certain that strength would win the day.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Deborah gave the signal. Barak and his people swept down Mount Tabor—and the heavens opened.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Kishon River flooded; the heavy chariots sank into mud, and the frightened army scattered.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Up! This is the day the Lord has given Sisera into your hands.
